# Scarp Studio v0.0.1-alpha.2 — Windows editor-only maintenance pre-release

**Experimental, unsigned Windows x64 pre-release.** This is not a stable IDE. It updates the editor foundation; it does not include the in-development compiler integration.

## Included
- Scarp-only `.srp` Monaco editing, syntax coloring, tabs, file open/save/Save As, dirty indicators and unsaved-change prompts.
- Top-level `.srp` folder browsing, keyboard shortcuts and light/dark themes.
- Prevent simultaneous native window-close discard confirmation dialogs. Repeated close attempts no longer bypass an active unsaved-changes decision.
- Match `0.0.1-alpha.2` versions across application, native bundle, npm and Cargo lockfiles.
- Verify Windows frontend, Rust, executable and NSIS packaging; attach SHA-256 checksums of release artifacts.

## Not included
Compiler Run/Verify/Stop ([draft PR #5](https://github.com/scarp-lang/scarp-studio/pull/5)) and compiler diagnostics ([draft PR #6](https://github.com/scarp-lang/scarp-studio/pull/6)) are **not in this pre-release**. There is no interactive terminal, debugger, language server, recursive project explorer or Linux/macOS installer.

## Important safety and limitations
Passing Windows CI is not the same as hands-on Windows 11 acceptance. Unsigned installer review, GUI launch, open/save/reopen, tab-close and unsaved-change prompts, folder access and theme switching still need manual verification; see [issue #2](https://github.com/scarp-lang/scarp-studio/issues/2).

Use disposable test `.srp` files and keep independent backups. Do not bypass Windows security warnings unless you independently verify and trust the files. Check each asset using `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Standard Tauri/WebView2 runtime prerequisites apply.
